prompts.title: Business Model Canvas Generator
prompts.prompt: Act as a business strategist. Create a complete Business Model Canvas for [BUSINESS IDEA]. Include: 1) Key Partners, 2) Key Activities, 3) Key Resources, 4) Value Propositions, 5) Customer Relationships, 6) Channels, 7) Customer Segments, 8) Cost Structure, 9) Revenue Streams. Be specific and actionable for each section.

prompts.title: SWOT Analysis Deep Dive
prompts.prompt: Conduct a comprehensive SWOT analysis for [COMPANY/PRODUCT]. For each category (Strengths, Weaknesses, Opportunities, Threats), provide 5 detailed points with explanations. Then suggest 3 strategic actions based on the analysis.

prompts.title: Competitor Analysis Framework
prompts.prompt: Act as a competitive intelligence analyst. Analyze [MY COMPANY] vs [TOP 3 COMPETITORS]. Compare across: pricing, features, target market, marketing strategy, strengths, weaknesses, and market positioning. Output as a detailed comparison table with strategic recommendations.

prompts.title: Pricing Strategy Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Help me develop a pricing strategy for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Consider: production costs, competitor pricing, perceived value, target market willingness to pay, and market positioning. Provide 3 pricing tier options (basic, pro, enterprise) with justification for each.

prompts.title: Investor Pitch Deck Outline
prompts.prompt: Create a compelling 12-slide investor pitch deck outline for [STARTUP]. Include: Problem, Solution, Market Size, Product, Traction, Business Model, Go-to-Market Strategy, Competition, Team, Financial Projections, The Ask, and Appendix. For each slide, provide key talking points and suggested visuals.

prompts.title: OKR Framework Builder
prompts.prompt: Help me create quarterly OKRs (Objectives and Key Results) for [DEPARTMENT/ROLE]. Provide 3 objectives, each with 3-4 measurable key results. Make them ambitious yet achievable, aligned with company growth goals.

prompts.title: Market Entry Strategy
prompts.prompt: Act as a market entry consultant. I want to enter the [MARKET/INDUSTRY] in [GEOGRAPHIC REGION]. Analyze: market size, barriers to entry, regulatory considerations, competitive landscape, and recommend the best entry mode (direct, partnership, acquisition, JV). Provide a 90-day action plan.

prompts.title: Customer Persona Generator
prompts.prompt: Create 3 detailed customer personas for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. For each persona include: name, age, occupation, income, goals, pain points, buying triggers, preferred channels, objections, and a quote that captures their mindset. Make them realistic and actionable for marketing.

prompts.title: Revenue Stream Brainstormer
prompts.prompt: Generate 15 creative revenue stream ideas for [BUSINESS TYPE]. For each, estimate: implementation difficulty (1-10), time to revenue, potential monthly income, and upfront cost. Rank them by ROI potential.

prompts.title: Business Risk Assessment
prompts.prompt: Conduct a comprehensive risk assessment for [BUSINESS]. Identify risks across categories: financial, operational, legal, market, technology, and human resources. For each risk, rate probability (1-5) and impact (1-5), then provide mitigation strategies for high-priority risks.

prompts.title: Partnership Proposal Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling partnership proposal between [MY COMPANY] and [TARGET PARTNER]. Outline: mutual benefits, proposed collaboration structure, shared goals, responsibilities of each party, timeline, and success metrics. Make it professional and persuasive.

prompts.title: Cost Reduction Strategy
prompts.prompt: Act as a CFO. Analyze potential cost reduction opportunities for a [BUSINESS TYPE] with [REVENUE LEVEL] revenue. Identify areas across: operations, technology, marketing, staffing, and supply chain. For each suggestion, estimate annual savings and implementation difficulty.

prompts.title: Scalability Assessment
prompts.prompt: Evaluate the scalability of [BUSINESS MODEL]. Analyze: current bottlenecks, technology infrastructure needs, human resource requirements, operational processes, and financial implications. Provide a scaling roadmap with milestones for 2x, 5x, and 10x growth.

prompts.title: Exit Strategy Planner
prompts.prompt: Help me plan an exit strategy for [BUSINESS]. Compare options: acquisition, IPO, management buyout, merger, or liquidation. For each, analyze: timeline, valuation expectations, preparation needed, and probability of success. Recommend the best option with justification.

prompts.title: KPI Dashboard Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a KPI dashboard for [BUSINESS TYPE/DEPARTMENT]. Identify the top 10 KPIs to track, categorized by: financial, customer, operational, and growth metrics. For each KPI, define: what it measures, target value, frequency of measurement, and data source.

prompts.title: Lean Startup Experiment Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a lean startup experiment to validate [HYPOTHESIS]. Define: the hypothesis, minimum viable test, success criteria, metrics to track, timeline, budget, and what we'd do based on pass/fail results.

prompts.title: Business Plan Executive Summary
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling 2-page executive summary for a business plan about [BUSINESS IDEA]. Cover: problem, solution, market opportunity, business model, competitive advantage, team, financial highlights, and funding requirements. Make it investor-ready.

prompts.title: Merger & Acquisition Target Screener
prompts.prompt: Define criteria for identifying acquisition targets for [MY COMPANY] looking to [EXPAND INTO MARKET/ADD CAPABILITY]. Create a scoring framework evaluating: strategic fit, financial health, cultural compatibility, technology assets, and valuation reasonableness.

prompts.title: Change Management Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a change management plan for [ORGANIZATIONAL CHANGE]. Include: stakeholder analysis, communication strategy, training plan, resistance management approach, success metrics, and a 90-day rollout timeline.

prompts.title: Vendor Evaluation Matrix
prompts.prompt: Create a vendor evaluation framework for [CATEGORY OF SERVICE/PRODUCT]. Define 10 evaluation criteria with weights, a scoring system (1-5), and questions to ask each vendor. Provide a template comparison table for evaluating 3 vendors side by side.

prompts.title: Business Continuity Plan
prompts.prompt: Develop a business continuity plan for [BUSINESS TYPE]. Address: critical business functions, potential disruptions (natural, cyber, pandemic, supply chain), recovery strategies, communication protocols, and minimum viable operations for each scenario.

prompts.title: Franchise Model Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a franchise model for [BUSINESS]. Define: franchise fee structure, royalty rates, territory rights, training program, operational manuals needed, franchisee requirements, and support systems. Include financial projections for both franchisor and franchisee.

prompts.title: Startup Valuation Calculator
prompts.prompt: Help me value my startup: [DESCRIPTION]. Stage: [PRE-SEED/SEED/SERIES A]. Revenue: [AMOUNT]. Growth rate: [X%]. Use multiple methods: Berkus, Scorecard, VC Method, Comparable Analysis, and DCF. Explain each result and recommend a fair valuation range.

prompts.title: Negotiation Strategy Planner
prompts.prompt: Prepare a negotiation strategy for [NEGOTIATION SCENARIO]. Analyze: my BATNA, their likely BATNA, key interests (not positions), ZOPA estimation, concession plan, walk-away point, and tactics for creating value. Role-play potential objections.

prompts.title: Annual Operating Plan Builder
prompts.prompt: Create an annual operating plan for [BUSINESS]. Include: strategic objectives, departmental goals, revenue targets, budget allocation, hiring plan, key projects, quarterly milestones, and risk factors. Format as a clear executive document.

prompts.title: Board Meeting Prep
prompts.prompt: Prepare materials for a board meeting for [COMPANY]. Create: CEO update summary, financial performance dashboard, key wins, challenges and mitigation plans, strategic decisions needing board input, and proposed resolutions. Keep it concise and data-driven.

prompts.title: Startup Launch Checklist
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive pre-launch checklist for a [TYPE] startup launching in [TIMELINE]. Organize by category: Legal (incorporation, trademarks, contracts), Product (MVP readiness, testing, security), Marketing (website, social, content, PR), Operations (tools, processes, vendors), Finance (banking, accounting, pricing), and Team (roles, hiring, onboarding). Include who's responsible for each item and deadline.

prompts.title: 360 Marketing Campaign Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a complete 360-degree marketing campaign for [PRODUCT/SERVICE] targeting [AUDIENCE]. Include: campaign theme, key message, channels (social, email, paid ads, PR, events), content calendar, budget allocation, KPIs, and a 90-day timeline.

prompts.title: Facebook Ad Copy Generator
prompts.prompt: Write 10 variations of Facebook ad copy for [PRODUCT]. Target audience: [DESCRIPTION]. Include: 3 hook styles (question, bold statement, story), 2 body copy variations, clear CTAs, and suggested emoji usage. Optimize for high CTR.

prompts.title: Google Ads Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a Google Ads strategy for [BUSINESS]. Include: keyword research (20 keywords with match types), ad group structure, 3 ad copy variations per group, landing page recommendations, budget allocation, and bidding strategy. Target [GEOGRAPHIC AREA].

prompts.title: Content Calendar Creator
prompts.prompt: Create a 30-day content calendar for [BRAND] on [PLATFORM]. Include: daily post topics, content types (video, carousel, story, blog), captions, hashtag sets, best posting times, and content themes. Align with [MARKETING GOAL].

prompts.title: Brand Voice Development
prompts.prompt: Develop a comprehensive brand voice guide for [BRAND]. Define: brand personality traits (5 adjectives), tone variations (professional vs casual vs playful), vocabulary do's and don'ts, writing style examples, and sample phrases for common scenarios.

prompts.title: Influencer Outreach Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create an influencer marketing strategy for [PRODUCT]. Define: target influencer profile, follower range tiers, outreach message templates, compensation structure, content guidelines, deliverables, success metrics, and a list of 10 influencer archetypes to target.

prompts.title: Email Marketing Sequence
prompts.prompt: Write a 7-email nurture sequence for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Audience: [DESCRIPTION]. Include: subject lines, preview text, body copy, CTAs, and timing for each email. Map each email to the customer journey stage (awareness, interest, desire, action).

prompts.title: Marketing Funnel Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a complete marketing funnel for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Map out: TOFU (awareness), MOFU (consideration), BOFU (decision), and retention stages. For each stage, define: channels, content types, CTAs, tools needed, and KPIs to track.

prompts.title: Viral Content Blueprint
prompts.prompt: Generate 10 viral content ideas for [BRAND/NICHE] on [PLATFORM]. For each idea, explain: the hook, why it would go viral, format (video, image, text), estimated production time, and a draft of the content. Focus on shareability and emotional triggers.

prompts.title: Retargeting Campaign Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a retargeting campaign strategy for [WEBSITE/PRODUCT]. Define: audience segments (visitors, cart abandoners, past customers), ad creative for each segment, frequency caps, budget allocation, platform recommendations, and expected ROI.

prompts.title: Webinar Funnel Builder
prompts.prompt: Design a complete webinar funnel for [TOPIC/PRODUCT]. Include: webinar title, registration page copy, email reminder sequence, slide deck outline, offer/pitch script, post-webinar email sequence, and replay strategy. Target [AUDIENCE].

prompts.title: PR Strategy & Media Kit
prompts.prompt: Create a PR strategy for [COMPANY/LAUNCH]. Include: target publications (10), press release template, media pitch email templates, journalist outreach list criteria, media kit contents, talking points, and a 30-day PR timeline.

prompts.title: Social Media Audit Template
prompts.prompt: Conduct a comprehensive social media audit for [BRAND]. Analyze: current presence across platforms, content performance patterns, engagement rates, competitor benchmarking, audience demographics, and provide 10 prioritized recommendations with expected impact.

prompts.title: Guerilla Marketing Ideas
prompts.prompt: Generate 15 guerrilla marketing ideas for [BUSINESS] with a budget under $[AMOUNT]. For each idea: describe the concept, estimated cost, potential reach, viral potential, and implementation steps. Focus on creativity and unconventional approaches.

prompts.title: ABM (Account-Based Marketing) Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create an ABM strategy for targeting [TARGET ACCOUNTS]. Define: account selection criteria, personalization tactics, content strategy per account tier, channel mix, sales-marketing alignment process, and success metrics.

prompts.title: Affiliate Program Designer
prompts.prompt: Design an affiliate program for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Define: commission structure, cookie duration, payout thresholds, affiliate tiers, promotional materials to provide, recruitment strategy, fraud prevention measures, and tracking tools.

prompts.title: Seasonal Campaign Planner
prompts.prompt: Create a seasonal marketing campaign for [HOLIDAY/SEASON] for [BRAND]. Include: campaign concept, messaging, promotional offers, content calendar (4 weeks), channel strategy, budget breakdown, and KPI targets.

prompts.title: Customer Journey Mapper
prompts.prompt: Map the complete customer journey for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. For each stage (Discovery, Research, Purchase, Onboarding, Usage, Advocacy), identify: customer actions, touchpoints, emotions, pain points, opportunities, and content needs.

prompts.title: Brand Positioning Statement
prompts.prompt: Create a brand positioning framework for [BRAND]. Include: positioning statement, brand promise, unique value proposition, brand pillars (3-5), tagline options (10), brand story, and competitive differentiation analysis.

prompts.title: Growth Loop Designer
prompts.prompt: Identify and design 3 growth loops for [PRODUCT]. For each loop: describe the trigger, user action, viral coefficient, compounding effect, and how to optimize it. Focus on sustainable, self-reinforcing growth mechanisms.

prompts.title: Conversion Rate Optimization Audit
prompts.prompt: Create a CRO audit checklist for [WEBSITE/LANDING PAGE]. Analyze: above-the-fold elements, value proposition clarity, CTA visibility, form optimization, trust signals, page speed, mobile experience, and provide 10 prioritized improvements with expected impact.

prompts.title: Referral Program Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a referral program for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Define: incentive structure (double-sided rewards), reward types, program mechanics, referral tracking method, promotional strategy, success metrics, and a launch plan.

prompts.title: Podcast Marketing Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a podcast marketing strategy for [BRAND]. Include: show concept, target audience, episode topics (first 10), guest outreach strategy, promotion plan, monetization path, and growth tactics.

prompts.title: Event Marketing Playbook
prompts.prompt: Create an event marketing playbook for [TYPE OF EVENT]. Include: pre-event promotion (timeline, channels, messaging), at-event engagement tactics, post-event follow-up sequence, lead capture strategy, and ROI measurement framework.

prompts.title: TikTok Strategy Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a TikTok marketing strategy for [BRAND]. Include: content pillars, trending audio strategy, posting frequency, video format ideas (10), hashtag strategy, creator collaboration approach, and growth milestones.

prompts.title: Local SEO Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a local SEO strategy for [BUSINESS TYPE] in [CITY]. Include: Google Business Profile optimization, local keyword targets, review acquisition strategy, local citation building, location page optimization, and community engagement tactics.

prompts.title: Brand Voice Guidelines
prompts.prompt: Create comprehensive brand voice guidelines for [BRAND NAME] in [INDUSTRY]. Define: brand personality (3-5 traits with descriptions), voice spectrum (formal↔casual, serious↔playful, respectful↔irreverent), vocabulary (words we use vs words we avoid), writing principles (5 rules), sample do's and don'ts with before/after examples, tone by context (social, email, error messages, legal), and how to handle sensitive topics.

prompts.title: Blog Post Outline Generator
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive blog post outline for [TOPIC]. Target keyword: [KEYWORD]. Include: compelling title options (5), meta description, H2/H3 structure, key points for each section, internal linking opportunities, and a strong CTA. Target word count: [NUMBER].

prompts.title: YouTube Script Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a YouTube video script for [TOPIC]. Length: [MINUTES] minutes. Include: hook (first 15 seconds), intro, main content with B-roll suggestions, pattern interrupts every 2 minutes, and a strong outro with CTA. Target audience: [DESCRIPTION].

prompts.title: Podcast Show Notes Generator
prompts.prompt: Create comprehensive podcast show notes for an episode about [TOPIC] with guest [NAME]. Include: episode summary, 5 key takeaways, timestamps for main topics, guest bio, resources/links mentioned, quotes, and a CTA. Make it SEO-friendly.

prompts.title: LinkedIn Article Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a LinkedIn article about [TOPIC] for [TARGET AUDIENCE]. Tone: professional yet conversational. Include: scroll-stopping hook, personal story element, 3-5 key insights with actionable advice, and an engagement-driving closing question. 800-1200 words.

prompts.title: Newsletter Issue Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a newsletter issue for [NEWSLETTER NAME] about [TOPIC]. Include: personal intro, main story/content, 3 practical tips, a 'worth reading' section (industry news), reader spotlight, and a CTA. Tone: [TONE]. Length: 600-800 words.

prompts.title: Repurpose Content Multiplier
prompts.prompt: Take this content: [PASTE CONTENT] and repurpose it into: 1) 5 Twitter/X threads, 2) 3 LinkedIn posts, 3) 1 blog post summary, 4) 5 Instagram captions, 5) 1 YouTube short script, 6) 1 email newsletter section. Adapt tone for each platform.

prompts.title: Content Repurposing Pipeline
prompts.prompt: Design a content repurposing system for [PRIMARY CONTENT TYPE]. Map how one piece of content transforms into: blog post, social media posts (5), email, video script, infographic outline, and podcast topic. Create a workflow diagram in text.

prompts.title: SEO Article Writer
prompts.prompt: Write an SEO-optimized article about [TOPIC]. Primary keyword: [KEYWORD]. Secondary keywords: [KEYWORDS]. Include: optimized H1, structured H2/H3 headings, meta description, FAQ section, internal linking suggestions, and natural keyword placement. 1500-2000 words.

prompts.title: Video Script Hook Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 15 scroll-stopping video hooks for [TOPIC] on [PLATFORM]. Use different hook types: question, bold claim, story, statistic, contradiction, behind-the-scenes, and listicle. For each, explain why it works psychologically.

prompts.title: Infographic Content Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan an infographic about [TOPIC]. Include: main title, subtitle, data points (8-10) with sources, visual structure (sections and flow), color palette suggestion, icon recommendations, and a distribution strategy.

prompts.title: Instagram Carousel Designer
prompts.prompt: Plan a 10-slide Instagram carousel about [TOPIC]. For each slide, provide: slide number, headline, body text, visual suggestion, and design notes. Include a strong cover slide hook and CTA slide.

prompts.title: Case Study Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling case study for [CLIENT/PROJECT]. Structure: Challenge, Solution, Implementation, Results (with metrics), Testimonial, and CTA. Include specific numbers and data points. Make it 800-1200 words, client-ready.

prompts.title: White Paper Outline
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed white paper outline for [TOPIC/INDUSTRY]. Include: executive summary, problem statement, market analysis, proposed solution, methodology, data/findings, recommendations, and conclusion. Suggest charts and visuals for each section.

prompts.title: Twitter/X Thread Builder
prompts.prompt: Write a viral Twitter/X thread about [TOPIC]. Include: hook tweet (scroll-stopping), 7-10 content tweets (one idea per tweet), actionable takeaways, and a CTA tweet. Make each tweet stand alone but flow as a narrative. Include suggested images.

prompts.title: Content Gap Analysis
prompts.prompt: Perform a content gap analysis for [WEBSITE] vs [TOP 3 COMPETITORS]. Identify: topics competitors rank for that we don't, content quality differences, keyword opportunities, and format gaps (video, podcast, tools). Provide 20 prioritized content ideas.

prompts.title: E-book Chapter Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a complete chapter for an e-book about [TOPIC]. Chapter title: [TITLE]. Include: chapter intro, 3-4 main sections with actionable advice, real-world examples, diagrams/visual descriptions, chapter summary, and discussion questions.

prompts.title: Press Release Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a professional press release for [ANNOUNCEMENT]. Include: headline, dateline, compelling lead paragraph, body with quotes, boilerplate, and media contact info. Target: [PUBLICATION TYPE]. Keep it under 500 words, AP style.

prompts.title: User-Generated Content Campaign
prompts.prompt: Design a UGC campaign for [BRAND]. Include: campaign concept, hashtag strategy, participation mechanics, incentive structure, content guidelines, moderation plan, repurposing strategy, and success metrics.

prompts.title: Tutorial/Guide Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a step-by-step tutorial for [TASK/SKILL]. Target audience: [LEVEL]. Include: prerequisites, materials/tools needed, numbered steps with screenshots descriptions, troubleshooting tips, pro tips, and next steps. Make it beginner-friendly.

prompts.title: Story Brand Script
prompts.prompt: Using the StoryBrand framework, write brand messaging for [BUSINESS]. Include: character (customer), problem (external/internal/philosophical), guide (brand), plan (3 steps), success/failure stakes, and a one-liner. Provide copy for website hero section.

prompts.title: Content Repurposing Machine
prompts.prompt: I created this [ORIGINAL CONTENT - e.g., YouTube video/podcast/blog post]: [DESCRIBE OR PASTE]. Create a repurposing plan: 5 Twitter/X posts, 3 LinkedIn posts, 1 Instagram carousel, 2 short-form video scripts, 1 email newsletter section, 1 blog post outline, and 3 story angles for different audiences. For each: the specific extract, platform adaptation, and hook.

prompts.title: Editorial Calendar Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a 3-month editorial calendar for [BRAND/CONTENT FOCUS]. Platforms: [LIST]. Publishing frequency: [DESCRIBE]. Content pillars: [LIST 3-5]. For each week: content themes, specific post topics per pillar, platform assignments, content format (video/carousel/text), keyword targets, and assigned writer/creator. Include key dates/holidays to align with.

prompts.title: Content Audit Framework
prompts.prompt: Create a content audit framework for [WEBSITE/BLOG] with [NUMBER] existing pieces. Process: inventory all content, categorize by topic/format/date, evaluate performance metrics (traffic, engagement, conversions), quality assessment (accuracy, relevance, readability), action decision (keep/update/merge/delete), and prioritized update list. Include a scoring rubric and audit template.

prompts.title: YouTube Script Structure Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Optimize this YouTube video script for retention: [PASTE OR DESCRIBE]. Apply retention principles: 0-15s hook (pattern interrupt + promise), 15-60s setup (context + stakes), body (pattern of open loops and payoffs), mid-video re-engagement, pattern interrupts every 60-90s, CTA placement (not too early), and strong ending. Rewrite the script with retention timestamps.

prompts.title: Podcast Show Notes Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Create optimized show notes for this podcast episode: [PASTE EPISODE DESCRIPTION]. Include: SEO-optimized title, 3-sentence summary, bullet-point key takeaways (5-7), timestamped segments, guest bio with links, resources/tools mentioned, call-to-action (subscribe/review/follow), transcription excerpt, and social media quote graphics suggestions.

prompts.title: Landing Page Copywriter
prompts.prompt: Write complete landing page copy for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Include: above-the-fold headline, subheadline, CTA, social proof section, benefits section (6 benefits), feature breakdown, FAQ (5 questions), guarantee section, and final CTA. Target audience: [DESCRIPTION].

prompts.title: Sales Page Long-Form
prompts.prompt: Write a long-form sales page for [PRODUCT]. Use the PAS framework (Problem-Agitate-Solution). Include: pattern interrupt opening, story, problem identification, solution reveal, benefits, social proof, objection handling, offer stack, risk reversal, and urgency CTA. 2000+ words.

prompts.title: Cold Email Sequence
prompts.prompt: Write a 5-email cold outreach sequence for [PRODUCT/SERVICE] targeting [ICP]. Include: subject lines (3 options each), personalized opener templates, value proposition, case study/social proof, soft CTA, follow-up timing, and breakup email. Keep each email under 150 words.

prompts.title: VSL (Video Sales Letter) Script
prompts.prompt: Write a VSL script for [PRODUCT]. Length: 15-20 minutes. Include: hook, intro, problem identification, story, solution reveal, demonstration, benefits deep dive, social proof, objection handling, offer presentation, bonuses, guarantee, urgency, and CTA.

prompts.title: Product Description Writer
prompts.prompt: Write 5 product description variations for [PRODUCT]. Target audience: [DESCRIPTION]. For each: use sensory language, highlight benefits (not just features), address objections, include keywords for SEO, and end with a compelling CTA. 150-200 words each.

prompts.title: Ad Copy Formula Generator
prompts.prompt: Write ad copy for [PRODUCT] using 5 different copywriting formulas: AIDA, PAS, BAB (Before-After-Bridge), FAB (Features-Advantages-Benefits), and the 4 Cs. For each formula, provide a complete ad suitable for [PLATFORM]. Explain why each works.

prompts.title: Squeeze Page Copy
prompts.prompt: Write high-converting squeeze page copy for [LEAD MAGNET]. Include: attention-grabbing headline, subheadline, benefit bullet points (5), opt-in form copy, CTA button text, privacy assurance, and social proof. Keep it minimal and focused on one action.

prompts.title: Webinar Registration Copy
prompts.prompt: Write webinar registration page copy for [WEBINAR TOPIC]. Include: headline, subheadline, what you'll learn (5 bullets), speaker bio, date/time, social proof, urgency element, and CTA button text. Target audience: [DESCRIPTION].

prompts.title: Upsell Page Copywriter
prompts.prompt: Write an upsell/OTO (one-time offer) page for [PRODUCT]. Include: pattern interrupt headline, 'wait before you go' message, the special offer, value stack (why it's worth 10x), scarcity/urgency, guarantee, and yes/no CTAs. Make it irresistible.

prompts.title: Email Subject Line Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 30 email subject lines for [EMAIL PURPOSE/TOPIC]. Use different psychological triggers: curiosity, urgency, scarcity, benefit, personalization, storytelling, controversy, social proof, question, and pattern interrupt. Group them by trigger type.

prompts.title: Brand Story Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling brand origin story for [BRAND]. Include: the founding moment, the problem that sparked it, the mission, the struggles overcome, the values, and the vision for the future. Make it emotional, authentic, and memorable. 500-700 words.

prompts.title: CTA Optimization Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 20 CTA (Call to Action) variations for [PRODUCT/PAGE]. Use different approaches: action-oriented, value-driven, urgency-based, curiosity-inducing, risk-reversal, social proof, and personalized. Explain the psychology behind each.

prompts.title: Sales Email Sequence
prompts.prompt: Write a 5-email sales sequence for [PRODUCT]. Target: [AUDIENCE] who opted in for [LEAD MAGNET]. Sequence: Email 1 (Welcome + deliver lead magnet), Email 2 (Education + soft pitch), Email 3 (Case studies/social proof), Email 4 (Objection handling + FAQ), Email 5 (Urgency + final push).

prompts.title: About Us Page Copywriter
prompts.prompt: Write an 'About Us' page for [COMPANY]. Include: mission statement, origin story, core values, team highlights, achievements/milestones, and a vision for the future. Make it authentic and trust-building. 600-800 words.

prompts.title: Microcopy Writer
prompts.prompt: Write UX microcopy for [TYPE OF APP/WEBSITE]. Provide copy for: buttons, error messages, empty states, success messages, tooltips, onboarding steps, loading states, form labels, confirmation dialogs, and 404 page. Make it helpful and on-brand.

prompts.title: Direct Response Ad Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a direct response ad for [PRODUCT] in the style of [FAMOUS COPYWRITER]. Include: attention-grabbing headline, story-driven body copy, emotional triggers, specific benefits with proof, strong guarantee, clear CTA, and P.S. with additional offer.

prompts.title: Bundle Offer Copywriter
prompts.prompt: Create compelling copy for a product bundle: [PRODUCT 1 + PRODUCT 2 + PRODUCT 3]. Include: bundle name, value anchor (total individual value), bundle price, savings highlight, why they're better together, urgency element, and CTA.

prompts.title: Testimonial Enhancement
prompts.prompt: Take this raw testimonial: [PASTE TESTIMONIAL] and enhance it into 3 formats: 1) Short punchy quote for social media, 2) Detailed case study format, 3) Video testimonial script outline. Highlight key benefits and outcomes.

prompts.title: Microcopy & UX Writing
prompts.prompt: Create UX microcopy for a [APP TYPE] application. Each piece: concise, human, on-brand, and action-oriented. Provide alternatives where appropriate.

prompts.title: Full Code Reviewer

prompts.prompt: My job search for [ROLE] has been [STRUGGLING/SLOW]. Audit my strategy: application volume vs quality, resume ATS optimization, networking activity, interview conversion rate, and follow-up consistency. Identify the bottleneck and create a focused 30-day action plan to improve results. Include weekly metrics to track.

prompts.title: Resignation Letter Writer
prompts.prompt: Help me resign from my [JOB TITLE] position at [COMPANY] professionally. Write a resignation letter that: states last day clearly, expresses gratitude genuinely, offers transition support, avoids negativity, and protects my reputation. Also provide: verbal resignation script, counter-offer response, and exit interview guidance.

prompts.title: Promotion Business Case
prompts.prompt: I want to make the case for my promotion from [CURRENT] to [TARGET]. Help me build a business case: document my achievements with quantified impact, list responsibilities I've taken on beyond my role, show market data for the target role, identify decision-makers, create a timeline for the conversation, and script the actual request.

prompts.title: Freelance Rate Calculator
prompts.prompt: Help me determine my freelance rate for [SERVICE/SKILL]. Consider: my experience level, market rates, cost of doing business (taxes, insurance, tools, time off), desired annual income, billable vs non-billable hours, and value-based pricing. Calculate 3 pricing models: hourly, project-based, and retainer. Provide scripts for quoting rates confidently.

prompts.title: Workplace Conflict Resolver
prompts.prompt: I'm having a conflict with [COWORKER/MANAGER] about [SITUATION]. Act as a mediator. Help me: see their perspective objectively, identify my role in the conflict, prepare talking points, script a direct conversation, de-escalate if emotions run high, propose solutions, and know when to involve HR. Prioritize professional relationship preservation.

prompts.title: Side Hustle Idea Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 15 realistic side hustle ideas for someone with skills in [YOUR SKILLS] who has [X] hours per week available. For each: describe the hustle, estimate startup cost, time to first dollar, monthly income potential, required tools/platforms, and how to scale. Rank by: fastest to revenue, highest hourly rate, and best long-term potential.

prompts.title: Reference Request Template
prompts.prompt: Write reference request messages to [TYPE OF PERSON - former boss, colleague, client] for my [JOB TITLE] application. Provide 3 versions (formal email, LinkedIn message, casual text). Each should: remind them of our relationship, explain the role I'm pursuing, highlight what I'd like them to mention, make it easy to say yes or no, and express gratitude.

prompts.title: Career Pivot Resume Bridge
prompts.prompt: I'm pivoting from [INDUSTRY/ROLE] to [TARGET INDUSTRY/ROLE]. Rewrite my resume to bridge the gap: reframe transferable skills using target industry language, highlight relevant projects/courses, reposition my summary, de-emphasize irrelevant experience, and add a 'Relevant Projects' or 'Skills' section. Explain why each change bridges the pivot.

prompts.title: Remote Work Productivity System
prompts.prompt: Design a remote work productivity system for [YOUR ROLE]. Address: workspace setup essentials, daily structure/routine, communication norms with team, async vs sync decision framework, deep work protection, avoiding overwork/burnout, virtual collaboration tools, and maintaining visibility for promotions while remote.

prompts.title: Dream Company Penetration Plan
prompts.prompt: I want to work at [DREAM COMPANY] as a [ROLE]. Create a multi-channel approach: find and connect with 5 employees on LinkedIn (with message templates), engage with their content, identify problems I can solve, create a value-demonstration project, find the hiring manager, craft a referral request, and time outreach around hiring cycles.

prompts.title: Day 1 at a New Job Plan
prompts.prompt: I'm starting a new job as [ROLE] at [COMPANY TYPE] on Monday. Create a 30-60-90 day plan. First 30 days: learn (people, systems, culture, expectations). 30-60 days: contribute (small wins, relationships, identify improvements). 60-90 days: own (take initiative, deliver visible results, establish credibility). For each phase: specific goals, questions to ask, relationships to build, and success indicators.

prompts.title: Story Premise Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 10 unique story premises for [GENRE]. Each premise should include: a compelling hook, the protagonist and their flaw, the central conflict, the stakes, what makes it fresh/different from existing works, and a one-sentence logline. Make them range from grounded to high-concept.

prompts.title: Character Development Deep Dive
prompts.prompt: Help me develop a complex character for my [GENRE] story. Starting with: [BASIC DESCRIPTION]. Create: full backstory (childhood wound, defining moment), personality (MBTI, strengths, fatal flaw), physical description, speech pattern, relationships, secrets, fears, desires, arc (what they need vs what they want), and their voice in first person.

prompts.title: World Building Guide
prompts.prompt: Help me build the world for my [GENRE] story. The core concept: [DESCRIBE]. Develop: geography and climate, political system, economy and currency, religion/beliefs, social hierarchy, technology/magic system (with rules and costs), history (3 major events), daily life details, cultural norms, and potential conflicts within the world.

prompts.title: Plot Structure Architect
prompts.prompt: Architect a [LENGTH] plot for my [GENRE] story about [CONCEPT]. Use the [Save the Cat / Hero's Journey / Three-Act] structure. For each beat: describe what happens, how it raises stakes, character development moment, estimated page/word count, and the emotional arc. Include subplot integration points and a twist suggestion.

prompts.title: Dialogue Enhancement Coach
prompts.prompt: Improve this dialogue to make it natural and character-specific: [PASTE DIALOGUE]. Rewrite it to: give each character a distinct voice, add subtext (what's unsaid), remove exposition-heavy lines, add action beats, vary rhythm (short punches and longer flows), and advance plot or reveal character. Explain what changed and why.

prompts.title: Scene Structure Builder
prompts.prompt: Help me structure a critical scene: [DESCRIBE THE SCENE]. Define: the scene goal (what the POV character wants), conflict (what stands in their way), disaster/complication, sequel (reaction, dilemma, decision), emotional shift from start to end, sensory details to include, and how it connects to the next scene. Target: [WORD COUNT] words.

prompts.title: Poem Generator
prompts.prompt: Write a [STYLE - sonnet/haiku/free verse/spoken word] poem about [TOPIC/THEME]. Incorporate: vivid imagery (show don't tell), metaphor and simile, rhythm that matches the mood, line breaks for emphasis, and emotional progression. If formal style, follow the rules strictly. Provide a brief note on craft choices.

prompts.title: Short Story Completer
prompts.prompt: Here's the beginning of my short story: [PASTE]. Continue it for [WORD COUNT] words. Maintain: my writing style and voice, established character dynamics, story tone, pacing, and planted hints. Escalate the conflict toward a turning point. Do not resolve the story yet—end on a hook that compels reading.

prompts.title: Song Lyric Writer
prompts.prompt: Write lyrics for a [GENRE] song about [THEME/EMOTION]. Structure: Verse 1 (set the scene), Pre-chorus (build tension), Chorus (emotional core/hook), Verse 2 (develop the story), Pre-chorus, Chorus, Bridge (shift perspective/revelation), Chorus, Outro. Include rhyme scheme, suggested melody direction, and rhythm notes. Make it singable.

prompts.title: Screenplay Formatter
prompts.prompt: Convert this scene description into properly formatted screenplay format: [PASTE]. Format with: scene heading (INT./EXT., LOCATION, TIME), action lines (present tense, visual), character names (centered, caps), dialogue, parentheticals (sparingly), and transitions. Follow industry-standard formatting. Improve description to be cinematic.

prompts.title: Editing Pass Guide
prompts.prompt: Act as a developmental editor. Review this story: [PASTE]. Provide feedback on: pacing (where it drags or rushes), character consistency, plot holes, showing vs telling, dialogue naturalness, sensory engagement, emotional resonance, opening hook strength, and ending satisfaction. Prioritize: 3 things that work, 3 critical fixes, 3 polish suggestions.

prompts.title: Backstory Generator
prompts.prompt: Create a compelling backstory for [CHARACTER NAME/TYPE] in a [GENRE] setting. Include: birth/childhood circumstances, one traumatic event that shaped them, one joyous memory they cling to, relationship with parents, defining choice they made, skill they developed as coping, a secret they've never told, and how all of this explains their current behavior.

prompts.title: Villain Creator
prompts.prompt: Create a complex, memorable villain for my [GENRE] story. The hero is [DESCRIBE HERO]. The villain should: have understandable motivations (not evil for evil's sake), be the hero's mirror or shadow, have a philosophy that's almost convincing, possess strengths the hero lacks, have a personal connection to the hero, and a vulnerability the hero can exploit.

prompts.title: Chapter Outline Creator
prompts.prompt: Outline the next [NUMBER] chapters of my [GENRE] novel. Current state: [WHERE WE ARE]. For each chapter: chapter title, POV character, summary (2-3 sentences), key plot event, character development beat, emotional tone, cliffhanger or hook at chapter end, and how it advances the main story arc.

prompts.title: Writing Style Analyzer
prompts.prompt: Analyze my writing style from this sample: [PASTE]. Identify: sentence structure patterns, vocabulary level and preferences, dialogue-to-narration ratio, tense and POV consistency, pacing tendencies, recurring themes, tone, unique stylistic choices, and 3 authors with a similar style. Then suggest 3 techniques to strengthen my unique voice.

prompts.title: Flash Fiction Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a complete flash fiction story (500-750 words) about [PROMPT/THEME]. Requirements: single POV, one setting, one conflict, twist or revelation at the end. Every sentence must earn its place. Show character through action. Start in media res. No wasted words. End with emotional resonance.

prompts.title: Story Opening Hook Generator
prompts.prompt: Generate 10 opening lines/paragraphs for my [GENRE] story about [CONCEPT]. Each should: hook immediately (question, conflict, mystery, bold statement, vivid image), establish voice, imply stakes, avoid info-dumping, and make it impossible not to read the next line. Vary the technique: action, dialogue, introspection, world-building, mystery.

prompts.title: Magic System Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a hard magic system for my fantasy story. The system should: have clear rules, a cost/limitation (Sanderson's Second Law), a weakness, a source of power, categories/types, skill progression, societal impact, relationship to plot (Sanderson's First Law), and a way it can be abused. Make it original—not just elemental magic.

prompts.title: Memoir Chapter Writer
prompts.prompt: Help me write a chapter of my memoir about [LIFE EVENT]. Take my notes: [PASTE]. Structure it as a story: establish the before (normal), the inciting incident, the experience with sensory details and emotional honesty, the turning point or revelation, the aftermath, and the reflection (what it means now). Write in first person, present or past tense.

prompts.title: Writing Productivity Coach
prompts.prompt: Act as a writing coach. I want to write a [NOVEL/SCREENPLAY/SHORT STORY] but struggle with [PROBLEM - procrastination, perfectionism, blank page, editing while writing]. Create a personalized system: daily word count target, writing schedule, pre-writing ritual, anti-procrastination strategies, tracking system, rewards, and accountability structure.

prompts.title: Comedy Writing Coach
prompts.prompt: Act as a comedy writing coach. Help me add humor to [DESCRIBE YOUR WRITING]. Techniques to apply: setup and punchline structure, misdirection, rule of three, callback, exaggeration, specificity, self-deprecation (not too much), observational humor, and timing/pacing. Provide 5 humorous rewrites of my passages and explain the comedic mechanic in each. Keep it appropriate for [AUDIENCE].

prompts.title: Data Cleaning Pipeline
prompts.prompt: I have a dataset about [DESCRIBE DATA] with issues: [MISSING VALUES, DUPLICATES, OUTLIERS, FORMATTING]. Create a step-by-step data cleaning pipeline: identify and handle missing values (imputation strategy), remove duplicates, detect and treat outliers (with justification), standardize formats, validate data types, and document all changes. Provide Python code.

prompts.title: SQL Query Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Optimize this SQL query for performance: [PASTE QUERY]. Table structure: [DESCRIBE]. Analyze: full table scans, missing indexes, inefficient JOINs, subquery vs CTE, unnecessary columns, WHERE clause efficiency, and GROUP BY optimization. Rewrite the query, explain each change, suggest indexes to create, and estimate performance improvement.

prompts.title: Exploratory Data Analysis Plan
prompts.prompt: Create an EDA plan for my dataset about [DESCRIBE DOMAIN] with [NUMBER] rows and columns: [LIST COLUMNS]. Outline: summary statistics to compute, distributions to visualize (and chart types), correlations to explore, group-by analysis, time-series patterns (if applicable), outlier investigation, missing data analysis, and 5 key questions the data should answer.

prompts.title: Dashboard Design Blueprint
prompts.prompt: Design a [BUSINESS INTELLIGENCE / ANALYTICS] dashboard for [AUDIENCE] tracking [METRICS/KPIs]. Specify: layout grid, widget placement (top KPIs at top-left, trend charts below, detail tables at bottom), chart types for each metric, color scheme (max 5 colors), filter/slicer design, drill-down paths, refresh frequency, and annotation/note features.

prompts.title: A/B Test Designer
prompts.prompt: Design an A/B test for [WHAT YOU'RE TESTING] on [PLATFORM]. Define: hypothesis (null and alternative), primary metric, secondary metrics, minimum detectable effect, sample size calculation, test duration, traffic split, randomization method, success criteria, guardrail metrics, and analysis plan (statistical test, significance level, power).

prompts.title: Statistical Analysis Guide
prompts.prompt: I need to analyze data to answer: [RESEARCH QUESTION]. Data: [DESCRIBE]. Recommend: the appropriate statistical test (t-test, ANOVA, chi-square, regression, etc.) with justification, assumptions to verify, how to handle violations, effect size measure, software/code to use, interpretation guidelines, and how to report results to non-technical stakeholders.

prompts.title: Data Storytelling Framework
prompts.prompt: Transform these analysis findings into a compelling data story for [AUDIENCE]: [PASTE FINDINGS]. Structure: start with the hook (why should they care?), context (what we analyzed), key insight (the 'aha' moment), supporting evidence (2-3 visuals described), implications (what it means for them), recommended actions, and potential objections. Use the Minto Pyramid principle.

prompts.title: Machine Learning Model Selector
prompts.prompt: I want to predict [TARGET] from [DESCRIBE FEATURES]. Data size: [ROWS x COLUMNS]. Task type: [CLASSIFICATION/REGRESSION/CLUSTERING]. Recommend 3 suitable algorithms ranked by suitability. For each: why it fits, pros and cons, data preprocessing requirements, hyperparameters to tune, expected performance, and Python code to implement.

prompts.title: Customer Churn Analysis Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a churn analysis plan for [BUSINESS TYPE - SaaS/E-commerce/App]. Identify: definition of churn, data needed (usage, transactions, demographics, support tickets), features to engineer (recency, frequency, monetary, tenure, engagement trends), analysis approach (descriptive → predictive), retention strategy framework, and reporting cadence for stakeholders.

prompts.title: Revenue Forecasting Model
prompts.prompt: Build a revenue forecasting model for [BUSINESS TYPE]. Inputs available: [DESCRIBE DATA]. Recommend: forecasting method (time series, regression, ML), decomposition (trend, seasonality, cyclical, irregular), driver identification, scenario planning (base/upside/downside), confidence intervals, refresh frequency, and presentation format for executives.

prompts.title: Cohort Analysis Template
prompts.prompt: Design a cohort analysis for [BUSINESS TYPE - SaaS, e-commerce, mobile app]. Define: cohort grouping (sign-up date, first purchase, acquisition channel), metric to track (retention, revenue, engagement), time granularity (weekly/monthly), visualization format (heatmap/triangle table), insights to extract, and retention benchmarks. Provide SQL or Python template.

prompts.title: Funnel Analysis Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a conversion funnel analysis for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Steps: [DEFINE FUNNEL STAGES]. For each stage: define the event/condition, identify drop-off causes, benchmark conversion rate, suggest 3 optimization experiments, and estimate revenue impact of improving each stage by 10%. Include attribution model considerations and time-delay analysis.

prompts.title: Data Dictionary Creator
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive data dictionary for my dataset. Columns: [LIST]. For each column: provide field name, data type, description, allowed values/range, source, example value, null handling, transformation rules, dependencies, and PII/sensitivity classification. Format as a table. Add a section for data quality rules and validation checks.

prompts.title: KPI Tree Builder
prompts.prompt: Build a KPI tree for [BUSINESS TYPE]. Root: [NORTH STAR METRIC]. Decompose into: acquisition metrics, activation metrics, retention metrics, revenue metrics, and referral metrics. For each leaf metric: definition, formula, data source, target, frequency, owner, and how improving it affects the parent metric. Show the math connecting each level.

prompts.title: Survey Data Analyzer
prompts.prompt: I collected survey data about [TOPIC] with [NUMBER] responses. Questions: [LIST]. Create an analysis plan: response rate assessment, demographic breakdown, Likert scale analysis (distribution + central tendency), open-ended coding framework, cross-tabulation plan, significance testing, key insights template, and visualization recommendations for reporting.

prompts.title: Anomaly Detection Guide
prompts.prompt: Design an anomaly detection system for [DATA TYPE - metrics, logs, transactions]. Specify: what constitutes an anomaly for this use case, detection methods (statistical, ML, rule-based), threshold setting approach, false positive management, alerting design, root cause analysis workflow, and feedback loop for improving detection accuracy over time.

prompts.title: Pricing Analytics Framework
prompts.prompt: Create a pricing analytics framework for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Analyze: price elasticity estimation method, competitor price tracking, segment-based pricing opportunities, bundling analysis, promotional effectiveness, willingness-to-pay research plan, price testing strategy, and margin impact modeling. Provide a dashboard layout for pricing decisions.

prompts.title: Data Governance Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a data governance framework for [ORGANIZATION TYPE]. Address: data ownership matrix, quality standards and monitoring, access control model, privacy compliance (GDPR/CCPA), retention policies, lineage tracking, cataloging, stewardship roles, incident response, and audit procedures. Make it practical for a [SMALL/MID/LARGE] organization.

prompts.title: ETL Pipeline Designer
prompts.prompt: Design an ETL pipeline for [SOURCE] → [DESTINATION]. Data volume: [ESTIMATE]. Specify: extraction method and frequency, transformation steps (cleaning, enrichment, aggregation), loading strategy (full vs incremental), error handling and retry logic, data quality checks, monitoring and alerting, and technology stack recommendations with rationale.

prompts.title: Competitive Intelligence Dashboard
prompts.prompt: Design a competitive intelligence dashboard tracking [YOUR INDUSTRY]. Track for each competitor: pricing changes, feature launches, funding/news, social media sentiment, SEO visibility, content output, customer reviews/ratings, and hiring trends. Define data sources, collection frequency, analysis methods, and alert triggers for significant changes.

prompts.title: Data Visualization Best Practices
prompts.prompt: Create a data visualization best practices guide for [AUDIENCE - executives, analysts, general audience]. Cover: chart selection framework (when to use bar, line, scatter, heatmap, etc.), color theory for accessibility (colorblind-safe palettes), avoiding misleading visuals (truncated axes, 3D charts, dual axes), annotation and labeling, dashboard layout principles, and storytelling with data. Include before/after examples.

prompts.title: Budget Builder 50/30/20
prompts.prompt: Help me create a monthly budget using the 50/30/20 method. Income: [AMOUNT]. Fixed expenses: [LIST]. Categorize spending into Needs (50%), Wants (30%), and Savings/Debt (20%). Identify where I'm over/under budget, suggest specific cuts, create a tracking system, and set up sinking funds for irregular expenses.

prompts.title: Debt Payoff Strategy
prompts.prompt: I have these debts: [LIST WITH BALANCES, INTEREST RATES, MINIMUM PAYMENTS]. I can pay [AMOUNT] monthly total. Compare snowball vs avalanche methods. Create a month-by-month payoff timeline for each. Calculate total interest paid and time to debt-free for both. Recommend the best method for my psychology and math, with reasoning.

prompts.title: Emergency Fund Planner
prompts.prompt: Help me build an emergency fund. Current savings: [AMOUNT]. Monthly expenses: [AMOUNT]. Target: [3/6/12] months. Create: monthly savings target, timeline to fully funded, where to park the money (HYSA vs money market vs CD ladder), automation setup, what qualifies as an emergency (and what doesn't), and rebuild plan after using it.

prompts.title: Investment Portfolio Builder
prompts.prompt: I'm [AGE], risk tolerance [CONSERVATIVE/MODERATE/AGGRESSIVE], investing for [GOAL] in [TIMEFRAME]. Recommend an asset allocation: stocks/bonds/cash/alternatives percentages. Within stocks: domestic/international/large-cap/small-cap. Suggest specific low-cost index funds or ETFs for each slice. Include rebalancing schedule and contribution strategy.

prompts.title: Retirement Calculator Guide
prompts.prompt: I'm [AGE], want to retire at [AGE], currently have [AMOUNT] saved, saving [AMOUNT]/month. Estimate: will I hit my target? Run scenarios for different return rates (6%, 8%, 10%). Calculate the 4% rule withdrawal amount. Identify if I'm on track, ahead, or behind. Suggest specific changes to close any gap. Consider inflation.

prompts.title: Side Income Optimizer
prompts.prompt: I earn [AMOUNT] from my [JOB/SIDE HUSTLE]. Analyze: current effective tax rate, opportunities for tax-advantaged accounts (IRA, 401k, HSA), deductible expenses I'm missing, business structure considerations (LLC vs sole proprietor), quarterly tax estimation, and audit-proof recordkeeping system. Suggest 3 strategies to legally reduce tax burden.

prompts.title: House vs Rent Decision
prompts.prompt: I'm deciding whether to buy or rent in [CITY]. Home price: [AMOUNT]. Rent equivalent: [AMOUNT]. Down payment available: [AMOUNT]. Run the 5-year cost comparison: total cost of buying (down payment, mortgage, property tax, insurance, maintenance, HOA, closing costs) vs renting (rent + renter's insurance + opportunity cost of invested down payment).

prompts.title: Subscription Audit
prompts.prompt: Help me audit my subscriptions: [LIST WITH MONTHLY COSTS]. For each: evaluate usage frequency, cost per use, cheaper alternatives, duplicate services, and emotional attachment. Calculate total annual cost. Categorize: keep, downgrade, cancel. Estimate annual savings from recommended cuts. Create a system for ongoing subscription management.

prompts.title: Financial Independence Calculator
prompts.prompt: Calculate my path to FIRE (Financial Independence, Retire Early). Current age: [X], annual expenses: [X], current net worth: [X], annual savings rate: [X]%. Calculate: my FIRE number (25x annual expenses), years to FIRE at current savings rate, how accelerating savings by [X]% changes the timeline, and coast FIRE / lean FIRE / fat FIRE scenarios.

prompts.title: Expense Tracking System
prompts.prompt: Design an expense tracking system that I'll actually stick with. Consider: my style ([SPREADSHEET/APP/ENVELOPE]), categories relevant to my life, automation opportunities (bank API, receipt scanning), weekly review ritual, monthly close-out process, and annual summary for tax purposes. Include a starter spreadsheet template description with formulas.

prompts.title: First-Time Home Buyer Guide
prompts.prompt: I'm a first-time home buyer in [COUNTRY/STATE]. Create a step-by-step guide: financial preparation (credit score target, debt-to-income ratio, down payment), mortgage types and how to choose, pre-approval process, house hunting criteria, offer strategy, inspection and closing process, hidden costs, and first-year homeownership financial planning.

prompts.title: College Savings Planner
prompts.prompt: Help me plan for my [AGE]-year-old child's college education. Current savings: [AMOUNT]. Target school type: [PUBLIC/PRIVATE]. Create: estimated cost at college age (with inflation), monthly savings needed, account types (529, Coverdell, custodial), investment strategy within the account, and what-if scenarios for scholarships, in-state, or trade school.

prompts.title: Tax Deduction Finder
prompts.prompt: Based on my situation ([EMPLOYMENT STATUS, FILING STATUS, STATE]), identify all tax deductions and credits I likely qualify for. Consider: standard vs itemized, education, home office, self-employment, healthcare, charitable, retirement contributions, and energy credits. Estimate total tax savings. List documentation needed. Flag commonly missed deductions.

prompts.title: Net Worth Tracker
prompts.prompt: Create a system to track and grow my net worth. Current assets: [LIST]. Current liabilities: [LIST]. Design: a balance sheet template, monthly update process, growth strategies for each asset category, debt reduction priorities, milestone celebrations, and an annual net worth statement format. Include tracking of liquid vs illiquid assets.

prompts.title: Insurance Coverage Audit
prompts.prompt: Audit my insurance coverage. Current policies: [LIST]. Analyze: coverage gaps, over-insurance areas, deductible optimization, policy bundle opportunities, term life vs whole life analysis, disability insurance need calculation, umbrella policy recommendation, and annual review checklist. Estimate potential savings from optimization.

prompts.title: Passive Income Blueprint
prompts.prompt: Create a passive income blueprint for my situation. Starting capital: [AMOUNT]. Skills: [LIST]. Risk tolerance: [LEVEL]. Evaluate 10 passive income streams: dividend investing, REITs, peer-to-peer lending, digital products, course creation, affiliate marketing, rental properties, royalties, high-yield savings, and index fund portfolio. Rank by: capital needed, time to income, and risk.

prompts.title: Negotiation Script: Bills
prompts.prompt: Create scripts for negotiating lower rates on: internet/cable, phone bill, car insurance, gym membership, and subscription services. For each: research to do beforehand, exact opening line, negotiation tactics, what to ask for, escalation path (ask for retention department), and backup providers. Target: reduce monthly expenses by 15-20%.

prompts.title: Estate Planning Checklist
prompts.prompt: Create an estate planning checklist for my situation: [SINGLE/MARRIED/PARENT/HOMEOWNER]. Cover: will (what to include), trust (do I need one?), power of attorney, healthcare directive, beneficiary designations on all accounts, guardianship (if children), digital asset plan, letter of intent, document storage, and review schedule. Estimate cost for each.

prompts.title: Credit Score Improvement Plan
prompts.prompt: My current credit score is [SCORE]. Target: [SCORE]. Analyze: the 5 factors (payment history, utilization, age, mix, inquiries) and identify my weak spots. Create a 90-day improvement plan with: specific actions for each factor, dispute strategy for errors, credit utilization optimization, authorized user strategy, and monitoring system.

prompts.title: Charitable Giving Strategy
prompts.prompt: Help me create a charitable giving plan. Annual giving budget: [AMOUNT]. Causes I care about: [LIST]. Create: giving criteria for evaluating charities, research process (Charity Navigator, GiveWell), portfolio approach (local/global/impact), tax-efficient giving (bunching, DAF, appreciated stock), and an annual giving review process.

prompts.title: Tax-Loss Harvesting Strategy
prompts.prompt: Explain and create a tax-loss harvesting strategy for my investment portfolio: [DESCRIBE HOLDINGS]. Rules to follow: wash-sale rule (30 days), substantial similarity test, replacing with similar-but-not-identical assets, maintaining asset allocation, $3,000 ordinary income offset limit, carryforward rules. Create a step-by-step process with specific replacement suggestions for my holdings.

prompts.title: Money Conversation Guide for Couples
prompts.prompt: Create a guide for couples to discuss money openly. Cover: setting up the conversation (timing, environment, ground rules), key topics to align on (spending priorities, debt philosophy, savings goals, financial independence, combining vs separating finances), navigating income disparity, handling financial disagreements, money personality assessment, and creating a shared financial vision. Include conversation prompts.

prompts.title: Job Description Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a compelling job description for [JOB TITLE] at [COMPANY TYPE]. Include: company overview (2 sentences, exciting), role summary, 5 key responsibilities (outcome-focused not task-list), requirements (must-have vs nice-to-have), what we offer, growth opportunities, and inclusive language. Make it sell the role. Avoid jargon and generic phrases.

prompts.title: Interview Rubric Designer
prompts.prompt: Create a structured interview rubric for [JOB TITLE]. Define 5 competencies. For each: write 1 behavioral question, 1 situational question, what excellent/good/poor answers look like (with examples), follow-up probes, red flags, and scoring guide (1-5 scale). Include space for notes and an overall recommendation matrix.

prompts.title: Onboarding Plan Builder
prompts.prompt: Design a 90-day onboarding plan for a new [JOB TITLE]. Week 1: orientation and setup. Weeks 2-4: learning and shadowing. Weeks 5-8: guided contribution. Weeks 9-12: independent work. For each phase: goals, activities, training resources, check-ins, deliverables, success metrics, and feedback touchpoints. Include pre-day-one preparation.

prompts.title: Performance Review Template
prompts.prompt: Create a 360-degree performance review template for [ROLE]. Sections: self-assessment, peer feedback (3 questions), manager assessment, goal review, competency evaluation (rate 1-5 with evidence), development areas, career aspirations, and next-period goal-setting. Include calibration guide for managers and example language for each rating.

prompts.title: Employee Engagement Survey
prompts.prompt: Design an employee engagement survey for [COMPANY SIZE] company. Create 25 questions across: job satisfaction, manager relationship, team dynamics, growth opportunities, company culture, compensation fairness, work-life balance, and intent to stay. Mix Likert scale and open-ended. Include benchmark targets and an action-planning framework for results.

prompts.title: Compensation Strategy Builder
prompts.prompt: Design a compensation strategy for [COMPANY TYPE/SIZE]. Include: pay philosophy (market leader, match, or lag), salary band structure (how many bands, width, overlap), variable pay design (bonus/commission/equity), benefits package tiers, pay equity monitoring process, geographic adjustment policy, and communication guidelines for transparency.

prompts.title: Employee Handbook Outline
prompts.prompt: Create an employee handbook outline for a [STARTUP/SMALL BUSINESS/MID-SIZE] company. Cover: company mission and values, employment policies, code of conduct, compensation and benefits, leave policies, remote work policy, anti-harassment, health and safety, performance management, grievance procedure, and acknowledgments. Tone: warm but legally sound.

prompts.title: Conflict Resolution Protocol
prompts.prompt: Create a workplace conflict resolution protocol for [COMPANY TYPE]. Define: levels of conflict, when to self-resolve vs involve HR, mediation process steps, documentation requirements, confidentiality guidelines, escalation matrix, timeline expectations, and follow-up process. Include scripts for managers having initial conversations with conflicting parties.

prompts.title: Training Program Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a training program for [SKILL/TOPIC] for [AUDIENCE - new hires, managers, all staff]. Include: learning objectives, prerequisite knowledge, module breakdown (each with content, activity, assessment), delivery format (live/async/hybrid), materials needed, duration, measurement of learning transfer, and reinforcement plan.

prompts.title: Remote Work Policy Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a comprehensive remote/hybrid work policy for [COMPANY TYPE]. Address: eligibility criteria, equipment and stipend, core hours and flexibility, communication expectations, meeting norms, performance measurement (outcomes not hours), security requirements, tax/legal considerations, wellbeing support, and team-building practices.

prompts.title: Termination Script & Checklist
prompts.prompt: I need to terminate an employee for [REASON]. Create: a pre-termination checklist (documentation, legal review, final pay), script for the conversation (respectful, clear, brief), logistics (access revocation, equipment return, transition plan), communication to the team, and post-termination follow-up. Include DOs and DON'Ts to minimize legal risk.

prompts.title: Diversity & Inclusion Action Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a D&I action plan for [COMPANY TYPE/SIZE]. Include: current state assessment, goals (hiring, retention, promotion, culture), sourcing strategies for diverse candidates, interview process bias mitigation, employee resource group framework, inclusive policies checklist, training plan, measurement metrics, and accountability structure.

prompts.title: Exit Interview Guide
prompts.prompt: Design an exit interview process for departing [ROLE TYPE]. Create: interview invitation message, 15 questions covering reasons for leaving, job satisfaction, manager relationship, what would have made them stay, feedback on company culture, suggestions for improvement, and whether they'd recommend the company. Include analysis framework for trends.

prompts.title: Promotion Criteria Matrix
prompts.prompt: Create promotion criteria for [CURRENT LEVEL] to [NEXT LEVEL]. Define: technical skills required, leadership/impact expectations, scope of influence, autonomy level, and business outcomes expected at the next level. Create a self-assessment checklist, manager evaluation form, and a promotion packet template. Include calibration guidance.

prompts.title: Company Culture Assessment
prompts.prompt: Design a culture assessment for [COMPANY]. Create: a values alignment survey, behavioral culture indicators to observe, interview questions for employees at each level, physical/virtual workspace assessment, ritual and tradition audit, decision-making process evaluation, and a culture health scorecard. Output: findings template and recommendations format.

prompts.title: Recruitment Marketing Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a recruitment marketing strategy for [COMPANY] hiring [ROLES]. Include: employer value proposition, careers page optimization, job board strategy (free + paid), social media recruiting plan, employee referral program design, university recruitment plan, and talent pipeline nurturing. Budget: [AMOUNT]. Include metrics: cost per hire, time to fill, quality of hire.

prompts.title: Behavioral Interview Question Bank
prompts.prompt: Create a bank of 30 behavioral interview questions for [ROLE], organized by competency: Leadership (5), Problem-solving (5), Teamwork (5), Adaptability (5), Communication (5), Integrity (5). For each question: what it assesses, what a strong answer includes, red flags, and follow-up probes. Include guidance on avoiding biased questions.

prompts.title: Candidate Experience Designer
prompts.prompt: Map and optimize the candidate experience for [COMPANY]'s hiring process. Current stages: [LIST]. For each stage: candidate emotions, communication touchpoints, time-to-feedback, and friction points. Create: automated communication templates, realistic timeline expectations, feedback delivery framework, and a 'candidate delight' moment at each stage.

prompts.title: Angry Customer De-escalation
prompts.prompt: A customer is furious about [ISSUE]. Write a response using the HEARD framework: Hear, Empathize, Apologize, Resolve, Diagnose. Provide 3 response versions (email, live chat, phone script). Tone: calm, genuine, accountable. Never blame the customer. Include: immediate fix, goodwill gesture, and follow-up plan to rebuild trust.

prompts.title: Knowledge Base Article Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a knowledge base article for [COMMON CUSTOMER QUESTION]. Structure: clear title (phrased as a question), 1-sentence summary, step-by-step solution (numbered, with screenshots described), common error messages and fixes, video script suggestion, related articles, last updated date, and feedback prompt. Write at a 6th-grade reading level.

prompts.title: Response Template Library
prompts.prompt: Create a library of 20 customer support response templates for [PRODUCT/SERVICE TYPE]. Categories: greetings, technical issues, billing questions, feature requests, refunds, account access, complaints, positive feedback, follow-ups, and closings. Each template: [variable] placeholders, warm tone, concise, and includes next steps.

prompts.title: SLA Framework Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a Service Level Agreement framework for [SUPPORT TEAM SIZE] supporting [CUSTOMER COUNT]. Define: priority levels (critical/high/medium/low), response time targets for each, resolution time targets, escalation matrix, business hours vs 24/7, breach consequences, reporting metrics, and continuous improvement process.

prompts.title: Customer Feedback Analysis
prompts.prompt: I have [NUMBER] customer feedback responses about [TOPIC]. Create an analysis framework: categorization scheme (bug, feature request, praise, complaint, question), sentiment scoring method, theme identification process, priority matrix (frequency x impact), reporting template, and a system for closing the loop with customers who provided feedback.

prompts.title: Self-Service Portal Planner
prompts.prompt: Design a self-service support portal for [PRODUCT TYPE]. Include: content audit (what to migrate, create, retire), taxonomy/categories, search optimization strategy, article templates, video script library, community forum guidelines, chatbot integration plan, success metrics (deflection rate, CSAT), and content maintenance schedule.

prompts.title: Difficult Refund Decision
prompts.prompt: A customer is requesting a refund for [SITUATION] that falls [OUTSIDE/ON THE EDGE] of our policy. Our policy: [DESCRIBE]. Analyze: policy interpretation, customer lifetime value, word-of-mouth impact, precedent risk, and cost of the refund vs cost of the negative review. Provide a recommended decision and the exact response to the customer.

prompts.title: Support Metrics Dashboard
prompts.prompt: Design a support metrics dashboard for [TEAM]. Top-level: CSAT, NPS, First Response Time, Resolution Time, Reopen Rate, Ticket Volume, Backlog. For each metric: definition, target, current trend, breakdown options (by agent/channel/topic), alert thresholds, and weekly review cadence. Include coaching action triggers.

prompts.title: Proactive Outreach Campaign
prompts.prompt: Design a proactive customer outreach campaign for [SCENARIO - new feature, known issue, re-engagement]. Define: target segment, trigger criteria, message sequence (email, in-app, phone), personalization variables, tone guidelines, FAQ preparation, success metrics, and A/B test plan. Goal: reduce inbound tickets and increase satisfaction.

prompts.title: Onboarding Support Sequence
prompts.prompt: Create a day 1-30 customer onboarding support sequence for [PRODUCT TYPE]. Include: welcome message, first-login guidance, day-3 check-in, day-7 value realization check, day-14 tip campaign, day-21 feedback request, day-30 success review. For each touchpoint: channel, message template, common questions, and success criteria.

prompts.title: Customer Success Playbook
prompts.prompt: Create a customer success playbook for [PRODUCT TYPE - SaaS/App/Service]. Define: customer lifecycle stages, health score formula, risk signals and responses, expansion opportunities, advocacy milestones, renewal process, and escalation paths. Include trigger-based actions (e.g., if usage drops 50% in week → [action]).

prompts.title: Complaint Response Escalation
prompts.prompt: Create a complaint escalation matrix for [COMPANY TYPE]. Define: complaint levels (1-minor, 2-moderate, 3-serious, 4-critical), who handles each, response timelines, approval requirements, customer communication at each stage, executive notification triggers, legal/PR involvement criteria, and post-resolution review process.

prompts.title: Multi-Channel Support Strategy
prompts.prompt: Design a multi-channel support strategy for [BUSINESS TYPE]. Channels: email, live chat, phone, social media, in-app. For each: staffing model, hours, target response time, ticket routing rules, escalation triggers, and integration with central system. Include channel-specific tone guidelines and when to move conversations between channels.

prompts.title: Customer Health Score Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a customer health score model for [SaaS PRODUCT]. Inputs to consider: product usage frequency, feature adoption breadth, support ticket volume/trend, payment status, NPS/CSAT, time since last login, key action completion. Define: scoring formula, weight rationale, health thresholds (red/yellow/green), and automated actions for each threshold.

prompts.title: Churn Rescue Campaign
prompts.prompt: Create a churn rescue campaign for [PRODUCT]. Define: at-risk signals, intervention triggers, outreach sequence (who, what, when), offer/incentive strategy, win-back message templates, executive escalation criteria, success metrics, and learning capture for product improvement. Include template for root cause analysis of each saved/lost customer.

prompts.title: Customer Effort Score Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Help me reduce customer effort in [SUPPORT PROCESS]. Map the current customer journey for [COMMON ISSUE]: steps, touchpoints, effort points, and emotion. Identify: friction points, unnecessary steps, self-service opportunities, automation potential, and process simplification. Create a before/after comparison and an implementation plan targeting 50% effort reduction.

prompts.title: Chatbot Conversation Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a customer support chatbot for [PRODUCT TYPE]. Define: top 20 intents to handle, conversation flows for top 5 intents, fallback strategy, escalation to human criteria, personality and tone, greeting and menu structure, response templates, and handoff protocol with context passing. Include testing scenarios and success metrics.

prompts.title: Customer Advocacy Program Builder
prompts.prompt: Design a customer advocacy program for [PRODUCT/SERVICE]. Define: advocate personas, recruitment criteria and outreach, engagement tiers (reviewers, references, case studies, speakers), rewards and recognition, community platform, internal participation model (who from the company engages), success metrics, and program evolution plan.

prompts.title: Client Discovery Questionnaire
prompts.prompt: Design a discovery questionnaire for a consulting engagement with a [INDUSTRY] client seeking help with [PROBLEM AREA]. Create 20 questions covering: current state, pain points, goals, success metrics, constraints, stakeholders, timeline, budget, previous attempts, competitive landscape, and decision-making process. Order from broad to specific.

prompts.title: Consulting Proposal Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a consulting proposal for [CLIENT TYPE] experiencing [PROBLEM]. Include: executive summary, situation assessment, proposed approach (phases with deliverables), methodology, timeline with milestones, team composition and roles, investment and payment terms, assumptions and exclusions, success metrics, and next steps. Tone: confident and professional.

prompts.title: SWOT Facilitation Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a facilitation guide for leading a SWOT workshop with [CLIENT TYPE] leadership team. Include: pre-work for participants, 90-minute agenda with time blocks, ground rules, probing questions for each SWOT category, prioritization exercise, TOWS matrix (turn weaknesses into strengths, threats into opportunities), and deliverable template.

prompts.title: Process Improvement Plan
prompts.prompt: I'm consulting for a [COMPANY TYPE] with this problem: [DESCRIBE]. Apply Lean/Six Sigma principles. Create: current state process map description, waste identification (8 wastes), root cause analysis (5 Whys + Fishbone), future state design, improvement initiatives (ranked by impact/effort), implementation roadmap, and KPIs to track.

prompts.title: Change Management Framework
prompts.prompt: Create a change management plan for [ORGANIZATION] implementing [CHANGE]. Use Kotter's 8-step or ADKAR model. For each step: specific actions, timeline, stakeholders to engage, communication plan, resistance mitigation strategies, training needs, quick wins to build momentum, and success indicators. Include a stakeholder influence map.

prompts.title: Market Sizing Model
prompts.prompt: Help me size the market for [PRODUCT/SERVICE] in [GEOGRAPHY]. Use both top-down and bottom-up approaches. Top-down: TAM, SAM, SOM with sources. Bottom-up: number of potential customers x average spend. Include: market growth rate, trends affecting size, assumptions and confidence levels, data source recommendations, and sensitivity analysis.

prompts.title: Stakeholder Analysis Matrix
prompts.prompt: Create a stakeholder analysis for [PROJECT/CHANGE] at [ORGANIZATION]. List likely stakeholders. For each: assess interest level (1-5), influence level (1-5), current position (supporter/neutral/resister), what they care about, key message for them, engagement strategy (manage closely, keep satisfied, keep informed, monitor), and influence plan.

prompts.title: Business Case Builder
prompts.prompt: Build a business case for [INVESTMENT/INITIATIVE] at [COMPANY TYPE]. Include: problem statement, proposed solution, cost analysis (CapEx + OpEx over 3-5 years), benefit quantification (revenue increase + cost savings + risk reduction), ROI calculation, payback period, NPV, sensitivity analysis, risks and mitigations, alternatives considered, and recommendation.

prompts.title: Operating Model Design
prompts.prompt: Design a target operating model for [ORGANIZATION] post-[CHANGE/MERGER/TRANSFORMATION]. Define: value streams, organizational structure, governance model, processes (to-be), technology stack, people and capabilities needed, location strategy, performance metrics, and transition plan from current to future state. Create a one-page visual summary.

prompts.title: Consulting Engagement Kickoff
prompts.prompt: Create a kickoff agenda and materials for a consulting engagement with [CLIENT]. Include: 90-minute agenda, objectives for the meeting, introduction script, project overview presentation outline, roles and responsibilities (RACI), communication plan, governance cadence, risk register template, and action item template. Set the tone for partnership.

prompts.title: Digital Transformation Roadmap
prompts.prompt: Create a digital transformation roadmap for [INDUSTRY/COMPANY TYPE]. Current maturity: [DESCRIBE]. Define: target digital maturity across dimensions (customer experience, operations, culture, technology), initiatives sequenced by priority, dependencies, quick wins vs strategic bets, investment requirements, change management needs, and 3-year milestone plan.

prompts.title: Vendor Selection Framework
prompts.prompt: Create a vendor selection framework for [CATEGORY OF SPEND].
