Define: requirements (must-have and nice-to-have), evaluation criteria with weights, scoring methodology, RFP structure, vendor longlist strategy, demo evaluation guide, reference check questions, total cost of ownership model, negotiation levers, and recommendation template.

prompts.title: M&A Integration Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a post-merger integration plan for [ACQUIRING COMPANY] acquiring [TARGET COMPANY]. Define: integration approach (absorption/preservation/best-of-both), workstreams (culture, operations, IT, HR, finance, customer), Day 1 checklist, 30/60/90-day milestones, synergy targets and tracking, governance structure, communication plan, and risk mitigation.

prompts.title: Strategy Offsite Facilitation
prompts.prompt: Design a 2-day strategy offsite for [COMPANY TYPE]'s leadership team of [NUMBER] people. Day 1: retrospection and market analysis. Day 2: strategy formulation and commitment. Include: detailed agenda, pre-read materials, discussion formats, decision-making frameworks, breakout exercises, output templates, and post-offsite follow-up plan.

prompts.title: Cost Transformation Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a cost transformation strategy for [COMPANY TYPE] targeting [%] cost reduction. Analyze spend categories: people, technology, facilities, vendors, marketing, and operations. For each: identify reduction methods (eliminate, optimize, automate, outsource), estimate savings and implementation costs, assess impact on operations, and sequence initiatives by risk/reward.

prompts.title: Consulting Rate Calculator
prompts.prompt: Help me set consulting rates for [SERVICE/EXPERTISE]. My experience: [DESCRIBE]. Consider: target annual income, billable utilization rate (typically 60-70%), overhead costs, market rates by tier, value-based vs hourly pricing, retainer vs project pricing, and premium positioning factors. Calculate 3 rate scenarios and provide scripts for quoting rates to clients.

prompts.title: Thought Leadership Content Plan
prompts.prompt: Create a 90-day thought leadership content plan for a consultant in [FIELD]. Content types: LinkedIn posts (2x/week), long-form articles (biweekly), newsletter (weekly), speaking proposals (monthly), and one flagship resource (whitepaper/toolkit). For each: topics tied to [MY EXPERTISE], target audience, key message, CTA, and cross-posting strategy.

prompts.title: Client Retention Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a client retention strategy for my consulting practice in [FIELD]. Current clients: [DESCRIBE]. Include: relationship nurturing cadence (check-ins between engagements), value-add content (insights, templates, benchmarks), expansion opportunities (scope growth, new service lines), feedback and improvement loop, renewal/re-engagement timeline, pricing for loyalty, and creating switching costs through deep expertise.

prompts.title: Rental Property Analyzer
prompts.prompt: Analyze this rental property: Price [AMOUNT], Down payment [%], Interest rate [%], Rent [AMOUNT/month], Property tax [AMOUNT/year], Insurance [AMOUNT/year], HOA [AMOUNT/month]. Calculate: monthly mortgage payment, cash flow, cash-on-cash return, cap rate, 1% rule check, break-even occupancy, and 5-year projections. Recommend buy/pass with reasoning.

prompts.title: House Flipping Calculator
prompts.prompt: Analyze a house flip: Purchase price [AMOUNT], Repair costs [AMOUNT], After-Repair Value (ARV) [AMOUNT], Holding time [MONTHS], Financing [CASH/HARD MONEY/BANK]. Calculate: total project cost (purchase + repairs + holding + closing + selling), profit, ROI, 70% rule check, and best/worst case scenarios. Flag risks and include a deal-killing checklist.

prompts.title: Airbnb Listing Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Optimize my Airbnb listing for [PROPERTY TYPE] in [CITY]. Current title: [PASTE]. Rewrite: title (keyword-rich, benefit-driven), description (hooks guests, highlights unique features, addresses common concerns), amenities prioritization, photo order strategy, pricing recommendations, house rules (firm but welcoming), and automated message templates for guests.

prompts.title: Real Estate Market Analysis
prompts.prompt: Analyze the real estate market in [CITY/NEIGHBORHOOD] for [BUYING/SELLING/INVESTING]. Evaluate: median home prices and 5-year trend, days on market, inventory levels, price-to-rent ratio, job growth, population growth, school ratings, crime rates, development projects, and neighborhood trajectory. Recommend: buy, sell, or wait, with reasoning.

prompts.title: Tenant Screening Framework
prompts.prompt: Create a tenant screening framework for [PROPERTY TYPE] rental. Include: application requirements (income 3x rent, credit score minimum, references), background check process, red flags (not protected classes), approval/denial criteria documented consistently, adverse action process, security deposit logic, and lease addendum recommendations. Ensure Fair Housing compliance.

prompts.title: Lease Agreement Reviewer
prompts.prompt: Review this lease agreement for a tenant: [PASTE KEY TERMS]. Flag: unusual clauses, hidden costs, maintenance responsibility gaps, early termination penalties, rent increase terms, subletting restrictions, pet policies, security deposit terms, and ambiguous language. Provide negotiation points and specific counter-offer language for problematic clauses.

prompts.title: BRRRR Method Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan a BRRRR (Buy, Rehab, Rent, Refinance, Repeat) strategy for a property: Purchase [AMOUNT], Rehab [AMOUNT], ARV [AMOUNT], Expected rent [AMOUNT]. Calculate: total investment, refinance amount (75% of ARV), money left in deal, cash-on-cash return post-refinance, and how many repeats until target cash flow. Include risks: appraisal coming low, rehab overruns, refinance delays.

prompts.title: Property Management SOP
prompts.prompt: Create a property management standard operating procedure for [NUMBER] rental units. Cover: tenant onboarding, rent collection process, maintenance request handling (urgency tiers), vendor management, lease renewal process, move-out inspection, security deposit handling, eviction procedure, financial reporting, and emergency response protocol.

prompts.title: Wholesale Real Estate Deal Analyzer
prompts.prompt: Analyze a potential wholesale deal: Property [TYPE] at [ADDRESS/AREA], Estimated ARV [AMOUNT], Estimated repairs [AMOUNT], Seller's asking price [AMOUNT]. Calculate: maximum allowable offer (MAO) at 70% rule, assignment fee target, profit for end buyer, and whether this deal works. Include a script for negotiating with the seller and a buyer's list building strategy.

prompts.title: Mortgage Comparison Tool
prompts.prompt: Compare mortgage options for a [AMOUNT] loan: 30-year fixed at [%], 15-year fixed at [%], 7/1 ARM at [%], and [ANY OTHER]. For each: monthly payment, total interest paid, total cost, break-even analysis for paying points, and pros/cons. Factor in: how long I plan to stay ([YEARS]), my risk tolerance, and prepayment penalty considerations. Recommend with reasoning.

prompts.title: Rental Rate Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Help me set the optimal rent for my [PROPERTY TYPE] in [LOCATION]. Details: [BEDS/BATHS/SQFT/AMENITIES]. Analyze: comparable rentals (premium/average/below-average), seasonal pricing strategy, amenities premium, pet rent potential, utility responsibilities, and lease-incentive options (free month vs lower rate). Provide a pricing recommendation and adjustment triggers.

prompts.title: Real Estate Investment Portfolio Planner
prompts.prompt: I currently have [DESCRIBE PORTFOLIO - number of properties, types, equity, cash flow]. Goal: [TARGET - cash flow amount, portfolio size, retirement]. Create a 5-year acquisition plan: strategy (BRRRR, buy-and-hold, commercial), financing options, target markets, criteria checklist, annual milestones, tax considerations, and exit/transition strategy.

prompts.title: Home Inspection Checklist Generator
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive home inspection checklist for a [PROPERTY TYPE] buyer. Categories: exterior (roof, siding, drainage, landscaping), structural (foundation, walls, floors), systems (electrical, plumbing, HVAC), interior (windows, doors, appliances, fixtures), environmental (mold, radon, pests), and safety (smoke detectors, handrails, GFCI). Include red flags for each category.

prompts.title: REIT Investment Analyzer
prompts.prompt: Analyze these REITs for my portfolio: [LIST REIT NAMES/TICKERS]. For each: sector focus, dividend yield, payout ratio, FFO growth, debt-to-equity, occupancy rates, geographic diversification, and 5-year performance. Compare to sector benchmarks. Recommend allocation across REIT types (residential, commercial, healthcare, industrial, data centers) based on current economic conditions.

prompts.title: Seller's Closing Checklist
prompts.prompt: I'm selling my home. Create a closing checklist timeline from accepted offer to closing day. Cover: title search, appraisal scheduling, inspection negotiation, repair requests, buyer's loan progress, document preparation, final walk-through, closing disclosure review, moving logistics, utility transfers, address change, and tax implications.

prompts.title: Real Estate Listing Copywriter
prompts.prompt: Write compelling listing copy for a [PROPERTY TYPE] in [LOCATION]. Specs: [BEDS/BATHS/SQFT/LOT/PRICE]. Key features: [LIST]. Create: attention-grabbing headline (8-12 words), opening hook (2 sentences), feature highlights with emotional benefit, neighborhood description, call to action, and MLS-optimized version (character limits). Avoid clichés. Make it stand out.

prompts.title: Real Estate Investor Negotiation Script
prompts.prompt: Create negotiation scripts for a real estate investor making offers on [PROPERTY TYPE]. Scenarios: motivated seller, overpriced listing, multiple offers, off-market opportunity, price reduction request after inspection. For each: opening offer strategy, anchoring technique, concession trading framework, walk-away criteria, and relationship-preserving language.

prompts.title: Personalized Workout Plan Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a [NUMBER]-week workout plan for a [AGE]-year-old [MALE/FEMALE], [FITNESS LEVEL], goal: [LOSE WEIGHT/BUILD MUSCLE/ENDURANCE/GENERAL FITNESS]. Equipment: [GYM/HOME/BODYWEIGHT]. Available: [DAYS] days/week, [MINUTES] per session. Include: weekly split, exercises with sets/reps/rest, progressive overload plan, warm-up/cool-down, and deload week. Explain the rationale.

prompts.title: Meal Plan Generator
prompts.prompt: Create a 7-day meal plan for [GOAL - weight loss/muscle gain/maintenance]. Calories: [TARGET]. Dietary restrictions: [LIST]. Preferences: [LIST]. Include: 3 meals + 2 snacks daily, macro breakdown, grocery shopping list organized by store section, prep instructions for batch cooking, and estimated daily cost. Make it realistic and sustainable.

prompts.title: Habit-Based Nutrition Coach
prompts.prompt: Act as a nutrition coach. I'm [CURRENT EATING HABITS], [GOAL], [RESTRICTIONS]. Don't give me a restrictive diet. Instead, create 10 progressive weekly habits (e.g., week 1: drink water before each meal). For each habit: why it works, how to implement, common obstacles, success criteria, and how it builds on the previous week. Focus on sustainability over speed.

prompts.title: Sleep Optimization Protocol
prompts.prompt: Create a sleep optimization protocol. Current sleep issues: [DESCRIBE - trouble falling asleep, waking up, insufficient hours]. Address: sleep environment (temperature, light, noise, mattress), pre-sleep routine (90 min wind-down), daytime habits (caffeine, exercise, light exposure), sleep schedule consistency, relaxation techniques, and when to seek medical evaluation.

prompts.title: Stress Management Toolkit
prompts.prompt: Create a personalized stress management toolkit for someone dealing with [TYPE OF STRESS - work, personal, financial, health]. Include: 3-minute emergency techniques (box breathing, grounding), daily practices (10 min), weekly reset activities, monthly self-assessment, burnout warning signs, boundary-setting scripts, and professional help criteria.

prompts.title: Running Program Designer
prompts.prompt: Create a [NUMBER]-week running program for a [BEGINNER/INTERMEDIATE/ADVANCED] runner training for [5K/10K/HALF/MARATHON]. Current ability: [DESCRIBE]. Include: weekly schedule (runs with type - easy/tempo/long/interval), cross-training, strength exercises for runners, progression plan, rest/recovery protocol, and race-day strategy. Include injury prevention tips.

prompts.title: Calorie & Macro Calculator
prompts.prompt: Calculate my calorie and macro targets: [AGE], [GENDER], [HEIGHT], [WEIGHT], [ACTIVITY LEVEL], goal: [LOSE/GAIN/MAINTAIN]. Calculate: BMR (Mifflin-St Jeor), TDEE, target calories, protein/fat/carb split with reasoning, adjustment protocol (what to change if not progressing after 2 weeks), refeed day strategy, and tracking recommendations.

prompts.title: Home Gym Setup Planner
prompts.prompt: Design a home gym for [BUDGET] and [SPACE - room/garage/corner]. Fitness goals: [DESCRIBE]. Recommend: essential equipment ranked by priority, cost breakdown for 3 tiers (budget/quality/premium), space layout description, flooring and ventilation needs, storage solutions, and alternatives for each major exercise. Calculate cost-per-use over 5 years vs gym membership.

prompts.title: Injury Prevention & Recovery
prompts.prompt: I do [ACTIVITY/SPORT] and keep getting [TYPE OF INJURY]. Create an injury prevention and recovery plan: pre-activity warm-up (dynamic), mobility exercises targeting my weak points, strength imbalances to correct, post-activity recovery routine, warning signs to watch for, return-to-activity protocol after injury, and when to see a physical therapist.

prompts.title: Healthy Meal Prep System
prompts.prompt: Design a meal prep system for [NUMBER] people, [DIETARY NEEDS], [DAYS] of meals per prep session. Include: master ingredient list, batch-cook recipes (3 proteins, 3 carbs, 3 vegetables), mix-and-match combination guide, storage containers and organization, reheating instructions, food safety guidelines, and a 2-hour Sunday prep schedule.

prompts.title: Mental Health Journaling Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a mental health journaling system for managing [ANXIETY/DEPRESSION/STRESS/OVERWHELM]. Include: morning check-in prompts (mood, intention, gratitude), evening reflection (wins, challenges, tomorrow's focus), CBT thought records (situation, thought, evidence, reframe), mood tracking system, triggers log, and weekly pattern review. Include privacy and safety notes.

prompts.title: Desk Worker Health Protocol
prompts.prompt: Create a health protocol for someone who sits [HOURS] hours daily at a desk. Include: ergonomic setup checklist, movement breaks (every 30/60/90 min), desk stretches (neck, shoulders, hips, wrists), posture correction exercises, eye strain prevention (20-20-20), hydration system, nutrition strategies for energy, and after-work mobility routine.

prompts.title: Water Intake Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Create a personalized hydration plan. Current intake: [AMOUNT]. Activity level: [DESCRIBE]. Climate: [DESCRIBE]. Calculate: optimal daily intake, schedule (when to drink throughout the day), electrolyte considerations, signs of over/under-hydration, tracking system, hydration-rich foods to add, and adjustment for exercise, heat, and altitude.

prompts.title: Fitness Progress Tracker Design
prompts.prompt: Design a comprehensive fitness progress tracking system. Track: body metrics (weight, measurements, body fat %), performance (lift numbers, run times, reps), photos (frequency and posing guide), subjective measures (energy, sleep quality, confidence), habit adherence (workout completion, nutrition, sleep), and monthly review questions. Include what NOT to obsess over.

prompts.title: Fasting Protocol Designer
prompts.prompt: I want to try intermittent fasting. Goals: [DESCRIBE]. Current eating pattern: [DESCRIBE]. Health conditions: [LIST]. Recommend: fasting protocol (16:8, 18:6, 5:2, etc.) with rationale, transition plan (gradual adjustment), what to consume during fasting window, breaking-the-fast guidelines, workout timing, monitoring metrics, and red flags to stop.

prompts.title: Fitness Challenge Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a [NUMBER]-day fitness challenge for [AUDIENCE - beginners, busy professionals, seniors]. Goal: [DESCRIBE]. Include: daily workout (scalable for fitness levels), nutrition guidelines, habit tracking sheet, progress measurement method, community/check-in structure, motivational messages, modification options, and post-challenge transition plan.

prompts.title: Corporate Wellness Program
prompts.prompt: Design a corporate wellness program for [COMPANY SIZE] employees. Components: physical health (step challenge, ergonomic assessment, gym subsidy), mental health (meditation sessions, EAP, mental health days), nutrition (healthy snacks, lunch and learns), social (team activities), and measurement (participation rates, health outcomes, productivity, satisfaction). Include budget and ROI framework.

prompts.title: Post-Injury Return to Exercise Plan
prompts.prompt: I'm recovering from [INJURY] and want to return to [ACTIVITY/SPORT]. Create a phased return plan (always with a disclaimer to consult a doctor). Phase 1: pain-free range of motion. Phase 2: light resistance. Phase 3: functional movement. Phase 4: sport-specific drills. Phase 5: full return. For each phase: exercises, progression criteria, warning signs, and estimated duration. Include confidence-building strategies.

prompts.title: Healthy Habits for Night Shift Workers
prompts.prompt: Create a health and wellness guide for night shift workers. Address: sleep optimization (blackout curtains, sleep schedule consistency, melatonin timing), nutrition (meal timing, food choices for energy, avoiding the 3am crash), exercise scheduling, social/family life balance, mental health (isolation, depression risk), light exposure management, supplement considerations, and regular health monitoring.

prompts.title: Trip Itinerary Planner
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed [NUMBER]-day itinerary for [DESTINATION]. Travelers: [DESCRIBE - solo, couple, family with kids ages]. Budget: [AMOUNT]. Interests: [LIST - food, history, nature, adventure, nightlife]. Include: daily schedule with morning/afternoon/evening, specific places with addresses, transport between locations, meal recommendations, cost breakdown, and buffer time.

prompts.title: Travel Budget Optimizer
prompts.prompt: Optimize my travel budget for a trip to [DESTINATION] for [NUMBER] days. Total budget: [AMOUNT]. Analyze: flight booking strategy (timing, airlines, alternatives), accommodation options (hotel vs Airbnb vs hostel vs house-sit), daily food budget, activity prioritization, transportation, and hidden costs. Create a budget allocation and money-saving tips specific to this destination.

prompts.title: Packing List Generator
prompts.prompt: Create a comprehensive packing list for a [NUMBER]-day trip to [DESTINATION] in [SEASON], doing [ACTIVITIES]. Include: clothing (outfit-planned by day), toiletries, electronics (with adapters), documents, first aid, and destination-specific items. Distinguish: essential vs nice-to-have. Include carry-on vs checked bag split and a pre-departure checklist.

prompts.title: Event Planning Master Plan
prompts.prompt: Create an event planning master plan for [EVENT TYPE - conference, wedding, meetup, fundraiser] for [NUMBER] attendees. Timeline: [NUMBER] weeks out. Include: budget breakdown, venue criteria checklist, vendor categories with selection process, marketing/invitation timeline, day-of run sheet (minute by minute), contingency plans, and post-event evaluation.

prompts.title: Travel Hacking Strategy
prompts.prompt: Create a travel hacking strategy for [FREQUENT TRAVELER/OCCASIONAL]. Current points/miles: [DESCRIBE]. Home airport: [CODE]. Goal destination: [PLACE]. Analyze: best credit cards for signup bonuses, points earning strategy, redemption sweet spots, airline/hotel alliance optimization, status matching opportunities, and a 12-month plan to earn a [SPECIFIC] free flight or hotel stay.

prompts.title: Wedding Planning Timeline
prompts.prompt: Create a wedding planning timeline for a wedding in [NUMBER] months. Budget: [AMOUNT]. Guests: [NUMBER]. Style: [DESCRIBE]. Include: month-by-month checklist (12 months to day-of), budget allocation by category, vendor booking deadlines, invitation timeline, day-of coordination run sheet, and common budget-busters to avoid.

prompts.title: Conference Organizer Guide
prompts.prompt: Organize a [INDUSTRY/TOPIC] conference for [NUMBER] attendees over [NUMBER] days. Include: theme and content strategy, speaker outreach plan, sponsor packages, venue requirements, tech setup (AV, streaming, app), registration process, attendee experience journey, networking opportunities, post-event content strategy, and budget template.

prompts.title: Digital Nomad Destination Guide
prompts.prompt: I'm a digital nomad considering [CITY/COUNTRY] for [NUMBER] months. Analyze: cost of living breakdown (rent, food, transport, coworking), internet speed and reliability, visa requirements and digital nomad visa availability, safety (neighborhoods to avoid), community and networking, healthcare access, climate, pros/cons vs alternatives, and a first-week setup checklist.

prompts.title: Birthday Party Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan a [THEME] birthday party for a [AGE]-year-old, [NUMBER] guests, budget [AMOUNT]. Include: venue ideas, decoration concept, food and drink menu, entertainment/activities schedule, timeline (setup to cleanup), shopping list, DIY vs buy decisions, party favor ideas, and a contingency plan for weather (if outdoor). Make it memorable, not generic.

prompts.title: Group Trip Coordinator
prompts.prompt: I'm coordinating a group trip for [NUMBER] people to [DESTINATION] for [NUMBER] days. Create a coordination plan: group decision process, payment collection system and tool recommendations, shared document setup, itinerary proposal template, dietary/needs collection form, communication channels, conflict prevention strategies, and a shared expenses tracking system.

prompts.title: Restaurant Research Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a dining guide for [CITY] trip. Preferences: [CUISINE TYPES], [BUDGET RANGE], [DIETARY RESTRICTIONS]. For each meal of the trip, recommend: restaurant name, cuisine, price range, must-order dish, vibe/atmosphere, reservation necessity, and backup option. Include local food specialties to try and markets/street food worth visiting.

prompts.title: Volunteer Travel Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan a meaningful volunteer travel experience in [COUNTRY/REGION] for [DURATION]. Consider: reputable organizations (with vetting criteria), types of work matching my skills [DESCRIBE], cost structure (program fees + travel + living), visa requirements, vaccinations, cultural preparation, ethical volunteering guidelines, and how to continue impact after returning.

prompts.title: Corporate Retreat Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a [NUMBER]-day corporate retreat for [TEAM SIZE] at [COMPANY TYPE]. Goals: [TEAM BUILDING/STRATEGY/CELEBRATION]. Include: venue criteria, agenda with work sessions and team activities, dining and social plan, transportation logistics, swag/gift ideas, dietary and accessibility needs, budget breakdown, and post-retreat feedback survey.

prompts.title: Festival & Fair Organizer
prompts.prompt: Organize a [TYPE] festival/fair in [LOCATION] expecting [NUMBER] attendees. Include: concept and theme, vendor recruitment and management, entertainment schedule, permits and insurance, security and medical plan, parking and traffic flow, waste management, marketing campaign timeline, sponsorship tiers, volunteer coordination, and financial projections.

prompts.title: Travel Insurance Analyzer
prompts.prompt: Help me choose travel insurance for a trip to [DESTINATIONS] for [DURATION], doing [ACTIVITIES]. Compare coverage needs: medical emergencies, evacuation, trip cancellation/interruption, baggage loss, flight delays, adventure sports coverage, pre-existing conditions, and COVID-related coverage. Recommend coverage amounts and 3 specific providers to compare.

prompts.title: Solo Female Travel Safety Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a solo female travel safety guide for [DESTINATION/REGION]. Include: pre-trip research checklist, accommodation safety criteria, transportation safety tips, cultural norms and dress code, communication plan template, emergency resources (embassy, local emergency numbers, women's helplines), self-defense basics, common scams to avoid, and community resources/apps.

prompts.title: Accessible Travel Planner
prompts.prompt: Plan an accessible trip to [DESTINATION] for a traveler with [DISABILITY/ACCESSIBILITY NEED]. Include: accessible accommodation criteria and booking tips, transportation options, attraction accessibility research method, medical/equipment considerations, documentation needs, accessible restaurants and activities, backup plans, and relevant apps/resources.

prompts.title: Travel Photography Guide
prompts.prompt: Create a travel photography guide for [DESTINATION TYPE] using a [CAMERA TYPE - phone/DSLR/mirrorless]. Include: must-capture shot list (iconic + hidden gems), best times for lighting at key locations, composition tips for landscapes/street/architecture/food, cultural photography etiquette, backup and storage strategy, editing presets/style direction, and gear packing list with weight optimization.

prompts.title: Literature Review Framework
prompts.prompt: Help me structure a literature review on [TOPIC] for a [GRANT/THESIS/PAPER]. Define: search strategy (databases, keywords, inclusion/exclusion criteria), thematic organization approach, synthesis matrix template (author, year, methodology, findings, limitations), gap identification method, and narrative structure. Provide the first 3 paragraphs as a template.

prompts.title: Research Question Refiner
prompts.prompt: My broad research interest is [TOPIC]. Help me refine it into a research question using the FINER criteria (Feasible, Interesting, Novel, Ethical, Relevant). Generate 5 specific research questions, evaluate each against the criteria, identify the strongest one, and convert it into a testable hypothesis with independent and dependent variables clearly defined.

prompts.title: Methodology Selector
prompts.prompt: My research question is: [PASTE]. Help me choose the best methodology. Compare: quantitative vs qualitative vs mixed methods. For the recommended approach: justify the choice, identify the specific design (experiment, survey, case study, ethnography, etc.), define sampling strategy, outline data collection tools, and address validity/reliability concerns.

prompts.title: Survey Design Expert
prompts.prompt: Design a survey to measure [CONSTRUCT/VARIABLE] for [POPULATION]. Create 20 questions mixing types (Likert, multiple choice, open-ended, ranking). Ensure: face validity, construct validity, avoidance of leading/double-barreled questions, logical flow, demographic section placement, attention checks, and estimated completion time. Include a pre-test plan.

prompts.title: Grant Proposal Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a grant proposal for [FUNDING BODY] on [RESEARCH TOPIC]. Structure: specific aims (2-3 clear objectives), significance (gap in knowledge and impact), innovation (what's new), approach (preliminary data, methodology, timeline), budget justification, and broader impacts. Make it compelling to reviewers who may not be experts in my specific sub-field.

prompts.title: Systematic Review Protocol
prompts.prompt: Create a systematic review protocol following PRISMA guidelines for the question: [RESEARCH QUESTION]. Define: eligibility criteria (PICOS), information sources, search strategy (with example Boolean string), selection process, data extraction template, risk of bias assessment tool, synthesis method, and heterogeneity handling plan.

prompts.title: Academic Paper Abstract Writer
prompts.prompt: Write a structured abstract for my paper about [TOPIC]. Key findings: [SUMMARIZE]. Format: Background (2 sentences on context and gap), Methods (3 sentences on approach), Results (3 sentences on key findings with key numbers), Conclusions (2 sentences on implications), and Keywords (6-8 terms). Target: 250 words. Make every sentence information-dense.

prompts.title: Thesis Structure Planner
prompts.prompt: Create a detailed thesis/dissertation outline for [TOPIC] at [MASTERS/PHD] level. For each chapter: purpose, estimated page count, section breakdown, key arguments/claims, literature to cite, methodology details, and how it connects to the next chapter. Include milestone timeline: proposal, data collection, draft, defense. Flag common committee concerns per chapter.

prompts.title: Data Collection Plan
prompts.prompt: Design a data collection plan for my study on [TOPIC]. Method: [SURVEY/INTERVIEW/OBSERVATION/EXPERIMENT]. Include: operationalization of variables, instrument design (or selection of validated instruments), sampling plan (type, size calculation, recruitment strategy), data management procedures, quality control measures, ethics/IRB considerations, and timeline.

prompts.title: Peer Review Response Letter
prompts.prompt: I received peer reviews for my paper on [TOPIC]. Reviewer comments: [PASTE]. Draft a response letter. For each comment: quote the reviewer, respond respectfully, describe the exact change made (with page/line numbers), or provide a reasoned rebuttal. Start with a summary of major changes. Tone: appreciative, professional, non-defensive. Include revised manuscript notes.

prompts.title: Research Ethics Application
prompts.prompt: Prepare an IRB/ethics application for my study: [DESCRIBE STUDY]. Complete: study purpose, research design summary, participant population and recruitment, informed consent process, data privacy and storage plan, risk assessment (physical, psychological, social, economic), risk minimization strategies, debriefing plan, and researcher qualifications.

prompts.title: Conference Presentation Builder
prompts.prompt: Create a conference presentation for [CONFERENCE NAME/TYPE] based on my research: [DESCRIBE FINDINGS]. Duration: [MINUTES]. Outline: slide-by-slide breakdown, each with title, key points (max 4 bullets), visual description (chart, diagram, image), speaker notes, and audience engagement moments. Start with a hook, build the narrative, end with impact and Q&A prep.

prompts.title: Meta-Analysis Plan
prompts.prompt: Design a meta-analysis plan for [RESEARCH QUESTION]. Define: effect size metric (Cohen's d, odds ratio, correlation), literature search strategy, inclusion/exclusion criteria, coding sheet template, heterogeneity assessment (I², Q-test), publication bias detection (funnel plot, Egger's test), subgroup analysis plan, and software choice (RevMan, Comprehensive Meta-Analysis, R).

prompts.title: Interview Study Designer
prompts.prompt: Design a qualitative interview study on [TOPIC]. Include: interview approach (structured, semi-structured, unstructured) with justification, participant sampling strategy (purposive, snowball, maximum variation), interview guide with 15-20 main questions and probes, pilot plan, transcription approach, coding strategy (grounded theory, thematic analysis), and trustworthiness measures.

prompts.title: Science Communication Writer
prompts.prompt: Translate my research findings into accessible science communication for [AUDIENCE - general public, policymakers, students]. My research: [DESCRIBE]. Create: a 200-word plain-language summary, a 60-second elevator pitch, a social media thread (8 posts), 3 analogies for different audiences, FAQ with anticipated questions, and a headline that's accurate but compelling.

prompts.title: Research Grant Database Builder
prompts.prompt: Help me build a funding opportunity database for [RESEARCH AREA] at [CAREER STAGE]. Sources to search: federal agencies (NIH, NSF, etc.), foundations, professional associations, university internal grants, and international opportunities. Create a tracking template with: funder, amount, deadline, eligibility, fit assessment, required documents, and timeline. Prioritize by fit and deadline.
